Tuesday:
running: Open Ended Power Test
  - warmup: 15:00 @ 140-160 w
  - go: lap-button @ 55-65 %cp
  - run: 20:00 @ 250 w
  - recover: lap-button @ 100 w
  - run: 3:00 @ 110 %cp
  - cooldown: lap-button
Wednesday:
running: Syntax Stress Test
  - warmup: 10:00 @ 150w
  - run: 5:00 @ 200 - 220 watts
  - recover: 2:00 @ 140 w
  - run: 5:00 @ 90-95%cp
  - recover: 2:00 @ 60 - 70 pcp
  - run: 1:00 @ 350-370w
  - cooldown: 5:00 @ 130 watts
Friday:
running: Nested Power Intervals
  - warmup: 10:00 @ 60-70 %cp
  - repeat: 2
    - run: 1.5km @ 90-95 %cp
    - recover: 2:00 @ 60-70 %cp
    - repeat: 4
      - run: 0:30 @ 110-120 %cp
      - recover: 0:30 @ 50-60 %cp
    - recover: 3:00 @ 55-65 %cp
  - cooldown: 10:00 @ 60-70 %cp.
